code.description: The letter code of a Box 12 entry (values like C, D, DD, W), verbatim uppercase as printed in the vertical 'Code' rail of the blank form or at the left edge of the register column '12 See Instrs. for Box 12'. Identifies the row — Box 12 rows are aligned by this code at eval time, not by position.
code.title: Box 12 code

amount.description: Dollar amount printed beside the Box 12 code in any printed slot: '12a See instructions for box 12', '12b', '12c', or '12d' on the IRS blank, or in the register column '12 See Instrs. for Box 12'. JSON number exactly as printed; null if a code prints with no amount.
amount.title: Box 12 amount

description.description: Text label of a box '14 Other' entry, verbatim as printed, e.g. RISDI on this wave. Identifies the row — Box 14 rows are aligned by this description at eval time, not by position.
description.title: Box 14 description

amount.description: Dollar amount printed beside the description in box '14 Other'. JSON number exactly as printed; null if a description prints with no amount.
amount.title: Box 14 amount

state.description: Box '15 State' — the two-letter state abbreviation of the single printed state row, verbatim, e.g. RI. This copy prints one state row only; a multi-state W-2 (a second row in boxes 15-20) is out of scope for this schema version. (row 1 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows).
state.title: 15 State

employer_state_id.description: Box 15 'Employer’s state ID number' (the register variant caption reads 'state ID No.'). The state identification number verbatim as printed, keeping leading zeros, e.g. 05051707900. (row 1 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows).
employer_state_id.title: 15 Employer’s state ID number

state_wages.description: Box '16 State wages, tips, etc.' for the single printed state row. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank. (row 1 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows).
state_wages.title: 16 State wages, tips, etc.

state_income_tax.description: Box '17 State income tax' for the single printed state row. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank. (row 1 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows).
state_income_tax.title: 17 State income tax

local_wages.description: Amount in box '18 Local wages, tips, etc.' - the LOCAL wages column, distinct from box '16 State wages, tips, etc.' (do not copy the state amount here). Null when box 18 is blank, as it is on all RI register docs.
local_wages.title: 18 Local wages, tips, etc.

local_income_tax.description: Amount in box '19 Local income tax' - the LOCAL tax column, distinct from box '17 State income tax' (do not copy the state amount here). Null when box 19 is blank, as it is on all RI register docs.
local_income_tax.title: 19 Local income tax

locality_name.description: Box '20 Locality name' for the single printed state row, verbatim as printed; null if the box is blank (blank on all wave docs). (row 1 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows).
locality_name.title: 20 Locality name

state.description: Box '15 State' — the two-letter state abbreviation of the single printed state row, verbatim, e.g. RI. This copy prints one state row only; a multi-state W-2 (a second row in boxes 15-20) is out of scope for this schema version. (row 2 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows). The employer-reference register variant prints only one row - null there.
state.title: 15 State

employer_state_id.description: Box 15 'Employer’s state ID number' (the register variant caption reads 'state ID No.'). The state identification number verbatim as printed, keeping leading zeros, e.g. 05051707900. (row 2 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows). The employer-reference register variant prints only one row - null there.
employer_state_id.title: 15 Employer’s state ID number

state_wages.description: Box '16 State wages, tips, etc.' for the single printed state row. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank. (row 2 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows). The employer-reference register variant prints only one row - null there.
state_wages.title: 16 State wages, tips, etc.

state_income_tax.description: Box '17 State income tax' for the single printed state row. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank. (row 2 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows). The employer-reference register variant prints only one row - null there.
state_income_tax.title: 17 State income tax

local_wages.description: Amount in box '18 Local wages, tips, etc.' - the LOCAL wages column, distinct from box '16 State wages, tips, etc.' (do not copy the state amount here). Null when box 18 is blank, as it is on all RI register docs. (row 2 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows).
local_wages.title: 18 Local wages, tips, etc.

local_income_tax.description: Amount in box '19 Local income tax' - the LOCAL tax column, distinct from box '17 State income tax' (do not copy the state amount here). Null when box 19 is blank, as it is on all RI register docs. (row 2 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows).
local_income_tax.title: 19 Local income tax

locality_name.description: Box '20 Locality name' for the single printed state row, verbatim as printed; null if the box is blank (blank on all wave docs). (row 2 of the two printed 'boxes 15-20' entry rows). The employer-reference register variant prints only one row - null there.
locality_name.title: 20 Locality name

employee_ssn.description: Box 'a Employee's social security number'. These copies print a masked value, often with overstruck characters. Policy: if the last four digits are legibly printed (e.g. 'XXX-XX-9186'), return 'XXX-XX-' plus those digits; if the tail is fully masked/overstruck, return exactly 'XXX-XX-XXXX' (canonical 4-X form) - do NOT try to count the struck-out X characters. Null only if box a is entirely absent.
employee_ssn.title: a Employee’s social security number

employer_ein.description: Box 'b Employer identification number (EIN)'; the register variant caption under letter b reads 'identification number'. The employer federal EIN verbatim as printed, keeping the hyphen, e.g. 05-0517079.
employer_ein.title: b Employer identification number (EIN)

employer_name.description: First line of box 'c Employer’s name, address, and ZIP code' — the employer name only, verbatim as printed, e.g. PASCOAG UTILITY DISTRICT.
employer_name.title: c Employer name

employer_address.description: The lines of box 'c Employer’s name, address, and ZIP code' after the employer name — street or PO box, then city, state and ZIP, verbatim. Join printed lines with comma + space, e.g. PO BOX 107, PASCOAG RI 02859.
employer_address.title: c Employer address and ZIP code

void.description: The 'Void' checkbox printed beside box d. A mark (X or similar) INSIDE the box counts; the box outline alone is not a mark. Two-state policy: true ONLY if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise (unmarked, or this checkbox not printed on this copy). Never return null for this field.
void.title: Void checkbox

employee_name.description: Employee full name as printed. Blank form boxes: 'e Employee’s first name and initial', 'Last name', 'Suff.'; the register variant prints the name as the first line of the combined block 'e Employee’s name, address, and ZIP code'. Keep middle initial and any suffix verbatim, e.g. JENNA M ANTHONY.
employee_name.title: e Employee name (first name and initial, last name, suffix)

employee_address.description: Employee address: box 'f Employee’s address and ZIP code' on the blank form; the register variant prints it as the lines after the name inside the combined block 'e Employee’s name, address, and ZIP code'. Join printed lines with comma + space — street, then city, state and ZIP, verbatim, e.g. 221 EMERSON RD, HARRISVILLE RI 02830.
employee_address.title: f Employee address and ZIP code

box_1_wages.description: Box '1 Wages, tips, other compensation'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed (this register prints plain decimals such as 40093.72 — no thousands separators or dollar signs); null if the box is blank.
box_1_wages.title: 1 Wages, tips, other compensation

box_2_federal_income_tax_withheld.description: Box '2 Federal income tax withheld'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank.
box_2_federal_income_tax_withheld.title: 2 Federal income tax withheld

box_3_social_security_wages.description: Box '3 Social security wages'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank.
box_3_social_security_wages.title: 3 Social security wages

box_4_social_security_tax_withheld.description: Box '4 Social security tax withheld'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank.
box_4_social_security_tax_withheld.title: 4 Social security tax withheld

box_5_medicare_wages_and_tips.description: Box '5 Medicare wages and tips'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank.
box_5_medicare_wages_and_tips.title: 5 Medicare wages and tips

box_6_medicare_tax_withheld.description: Box '6 Medicare tax withheld'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank.
box_6_medicare_tax_withheld.title: 6 Medicare tax withheld

box_7_social_security_tips.description: Box '7 Social security tips'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank (printed but typically empty on this wave).
box_7_social_security_tips.title: 7 Social security tips

box_8_allocated_tips.description: Box '8 Allocated tips'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank (printed but typically empty on this wave).
box_8_allocated_tips.title: 8 Allocated tips

box_10_dependent_care_benefits.description: Box '10 Dependent care benefits'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank (printed but typically empty on this wave).
box_10_dependent_care_benefits.title: 10 Dependent care benefits

box_11_nonqualified_plans.description: Box '11 Nonqualified plans'. Dollar amount as a JSON number, exactly as printed; null if the box is blank (printed but typically empty on this wave).
box_11_nonqualified_plans.title: 11 Nonqualified plans

box_12.description: Box 12 coded amounts. The blank form prints four slots '12a See instructions for box 12', '12b', '12c', '12d', each with a vertical 'Code' rail; the register variant prints a single column headed '12 See Instrs. for Box 12' with one code letter and amount per line. One row per printed code entry, in print order; null if this copy prints no Box 12 entries.
box_12.title: 12 Box 12 coded amounts

box_13_statutory_employee.description: '13 Statutory employee' checkbox in the box-13 grid. Two-state policy: true ONLY if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise (unmarked, or this checkbox not printed on this copy). Never return null for this field.
box_13_statutory_employee.title: 13 Statutory employee

box_13_retirement_plan.description: 'Retirement plan' checkbox in the box-13 grid. Two-state policy: true ONLY if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise (unmarked, or this checkbox not printed on this copy). Never return null for this field.
box_13_retirement_plan.title: 13 Retirement plan

box_13_third_party_sick_pay.description: 'Third-party sick pay' checkbox in the box-13 grid. Two-state policy: true ONLY if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise (unmarked, or this checkbox not printed on this copy). Never return null for this field.
box_13_third_party_sick_pay.title: 13 Third-party sick pay

box_13_subtotal.description: 'Subtotal' checkbox in the box-13 grid (register variant only). Two-state policy: true ONLY if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise (unmarked, or this checkbox not printed on this copy). Never return null for this field.
box_13_subtotal.title: 13 Subtotal (register variant only)

box_14_other.description: Box '14 Other' — employer-defined deductions and benefits, e.g. RISDI on this wave. One row per printed description and amount pair, in print order; null if box 14 is blank.
box_14_other.title: 14 Other

state_local_row_1.description: The first printed entry row of boxes '15 State' through '20 Locality name'. Null when this row is entirely blank or not printed.
state_local_row_1.title: State/Local Row 1

state_local_row_2.description: The second printed entry row of boxes '15 State' through '20 Locality name'. Null when this row is entirely blank or not printed.
state_local_row_2.title: State/Local Row 2

control_number_line1.description: Box 'd Control number' - the FIRST printed line only (e.g. '0012-0012N426'). Verbatim.
control_number_line1.title: Control Number Line 1

control_number_line2.description: Box 'd Control number' - the SECOND printed line only (e.g. '0000000165-ELECTR'), the register sequence/type line. Verbatim; null if the box prints a single line.
control_number_line2.title: Control Number Line 2
